description.fallback: From Boruto and Momoshiki's previous discussion, the latter is shocked to hear the former's suggestion of letting him take over his body. Boruto assures him he is telling the truth and Momoshiki is aware that he is being truthful. Momoshiki acknowledges that the Human God Trees are enemies to the two, but also realises that Kawaki will come after him once their enemies are vanquished.
